title: Realize the full robust contract for every rank-one structure
statement: For one species let M be maximal nontrivial reactant order. Weak reversibility makes every increasing reaction have order<M and supplies a decreasing reaction of orderM. After fixed degree-K catalytic augmentation, total increasing intensity<=C_R V^a(1+n)^(M+K-1) and decreasing intensity>=c_R V^-a n^(M+K), uniformly under relative errors<=1/4, V=1+lambda+lambda^-1. Bounded jump sizes give for each FIXED s: tildeL(1+n)^s<=A_s(V)-b_s(V)(1+n)^s, with polynomial A_s,b_s^-1. These Foster bounds yield nonexplosion, classwise positive recurrence/uniqueness and every fixed stationary/transient moment; retain zero-change firings in resource counts. For arbitrary species and primitive rank-one directionv, mixed signs give a positive conservation law and finite classes. Otherwise orientv>=0; conserved coordinates select active linkages by fixed thresholds, and maximal growing-coordinate reactant degrees give the same domination with polynomial coefficients/thresholds in1+|x0|1+V_lambda. Use the conditional transfer to obtain the ENTIRE robust law/mean/time/firing/bit contract on all finite/infinite actual classes of EVERY fixed rank<=1 weakly reversible R. This does not cover general interacting higher-rank infinite classes.

assumptions: Complete positive results have EXACT finite-class, rank-one or specified-two-species scope; general interacting higher-rank infinite classes remain OPEN. Conditional transfer assumes, rather than proves generally, perturbed nonexplosion/positive recurrence/unique stationary law and sufficient uniform polynomial moments, including nominal evolution started from perturbed stationary laws. Zero per-firing gap concerns THIS uniform-degree catalytic clock, not every allowed augmentation or a full robust no-go. The native visible Sympy code verifies a nominal drift identity only; its code/output are preserved and not rerun by Capital. Literature/project citation snippets do not supply missing quantitative recurrence or robustness premises. No novelty, physical device advantage or independent validation is claimed; all held/unread sources and transfer limits persist. Existing N1782 conservative gap/equilibrium results and the new nonconservative nominal spatial-mixing theorem are not open questions. The nominal invariant-tail lemma does not prove independent-error recurrence/moments.
costs: Let L be COMPLETE binary input length and W=2+|x0|1+sum(lambda_i+lambda_i^-1)+epsilon^-1. All fixed preprocessing/catalysts/constants and arithmetic are paid; compiler work/memory/output polynomial inL. TimeT,inverse tolerance, inverse nominal coefficients and expected TOTAL ACTUAL labelled-channel firings must be<=C_R W^p_R. This is numerical population/activity/accuracy cost, not polynomial physical cost in logarithmic population. Use accepted nominal exact-law/gap constants once. Proof cutoffs truncate a comparison distribution, not the actual network. No transient/state oracle, software sampling substitute, free clock rescaling or scientific computation by Capital.
contract.units: Exact mathematical quantities and complete bit/resource contracts as stated; no physical or scientific execution by Capital.
obstruction: Construct a uniformly polynomial quantitative, independent-error-stable recurrence/moment certificate for EVERY interacting higher-rank infinite actual class, or prove a genuine obstruction over ALL permitted fixed catalytic choices. The nominal gap, finite cases, rank-one cases and this trapping example do not settle that universal endpoint.

review.scope: Supplied whole governing proofs at the stated hypotheses. Earlier shared constructions and imported theorems count once; no new independent audit or historical-priority claim.
